players.product: 800G/1.6T PAM4 ICs, 200G/lane photodetectors, TIAs/drivers, CW lasers (developing) for optical modules

quarterly_data.signal: MACOM runs a fab-lite manufacturing model: internal wafer fabs in Lowell, Massachusetts, Research Triangle Park (RTP), North Carolina, Ann Arbor, Michigan and Limeil-Brevannes, France make compound semiconductors including GaAs, GaN and InP, and internal assembly and test sites include Hsinchu, Taiwan; these are supplemented by external foundries and assembly and test suppliers (not named), and wafers for a given merchant-foundry process are generally sourced from a single foundry. With the RF business acquired from Wolfspeed, MACOM assumed control of the RTP wafer fab on July 25, 2025; before that transfer Wolfspeed operated the facility and supplied wafer product and fabrication services to MACOM.
